description: This file defines a React functional component named 'ComponentView' that is responsible for rendering a component within the web app. It manages loading states, error handling, subscription prompts, feature status updates, and embeds an iframe that displays the actual component content. The file includes hooks for lifecycle management and interactions with various services and observers.

methods.name: reloadValidityStatus
methods.description: Updates component validity, feature status, loading state, and error/status messages based on current componentViewer state.

methods.name: manageSubscription
methods.description: Opens the subscription dashboard for the application.

methods.name: dismissDeprecationMessage
methods.description: Handles the dismissal of deprecation messages.

methods.name: onVisibilityChange
methods.description: Handles visibility change events to trigger reload if loading issues are detected.

methods.name: onIframeLoad
methods.description: Handles the iframe's load event, sets the window context, and manages the loading state.
